pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "das Wohnzimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. lamp
   B. cupboard or wardrobe
   C. living room
   D. spoon

2. What does "Herzlichen Glückwunsch" express? (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Goodbye
   C. Congratulations
   D. I am hungry

3. Which verb do you use with "Wasser"? (1 mark)
   A. schlafen
   B. trinken
   C. essen
   D. kochen

4. What does "die Karotte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. meat
   C. fish
   D. carrot

5. Which two words is "Regenbogen" made from? (1 mark)
   A. Wind and Bogen
   B. Wolke and Bogen
   C. Regen and Bogen
   D. Regen and Sonne

6. What does "Guten Abend" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good night
   B. see you tomorrow
   C. What is your name?
   D. good evening

7. What does "das Kind" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. child
   B. brother
   C. father
   D. uncle

8. What does "dort" mean? (1 mark)
   A. here
   B. always
   C. there
   D. now

9. What does "das Wochenende" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. day
   C. weekend
   D. week

10. What does "Nein, danke" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Yes, please
   C. See you soon
   D. No, thank you

11. What are "Anführungszeichen"? (1 mark)
   A. Quotation marks
   B. Question marks
   C. Full stops
   D. Hyphens

12. Which German word is the number 5? (1 mark)
   A. elf
   B. vierzehn
   C. siebzehn
   D. fünf

13. Which month comes right after "Mai"? (1 mark)
   A. Juni
   B. März
   C. Januar
   D. November

14. What does "das Wasser" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. bean
   B. tea
   C. water
   D. banana

15. Which little word goes with the noun "Mango"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. den
   C. die
   D. der

16. Which little word goes with the noun "Kartoffel"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. die
   C. der
   D. den

17. Which little word goes with the noun "Bein"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

18. What does "neblig" mean? (1 mark)
   A. rainy
   B. cloudy
   C. foggy
   D. sunny

19. Which little word goes with the noun "Wind"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. der
   D. den

20. Which German word or phrase means "house"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kühlschrank
   B. die Toilette
   C. das Schlafzimmer
   D. das Haus

21. Which German word or phrase means "cooker"? (1 mark)
   A. die Dusche
   B. der Tisch
   C. der Herd
   D. die Küche

22. Which German word or phrase means "living room"? (1 mark)
   A. der Stuhl
   B. der Topf
   C. das Wohnzimmer
   D. die Uhr

23. Which German word or phrase means "day"? (1 mark)
   A. der Tag
   B. der Sonntag
   C. der Donnerstag
   D. der Mittwoch

24. Which little word goes with the noun "Wochenende"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

25. Which verb fits in "Am Sonntag ___ ich in die Kirche"? (1 mark)
   A. gehe
   B. gehen
   C. gehst
   D. geht

26. Which German word means "May"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. Mai
   C. September
   D. Januar

27. What does "der vierte" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. third
   B. sixth
   C. fourth
   D. fifth

28. Which form completes "Äpfel ___ gesund"? (1 mark)
   A. ist
   B. bist
   C. bin
   D. sind

29. Which adjective is made from "Wind"? (1 mark)
   A. windig
   B. windlich
   C. windich
   D. winden

30. Which little word goes with the noun "Wetter"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. das
   D. den

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the German words with der, die or das for: snow, brother, meat. (3 marks)

32. A child arrives at school in the morning. Write in German what the child says to the teacher, and how the teacher asks how the child is, and the child's answer. (4 marks)

33. Write the German words with der, die or das for: foot, head. (2 marks)

34. Explain what it means to listen for the gist of a text. (2 marks)

35. Write the singular and plural of Fuß in German. (2 marks)

36. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tea, tooth. (2 marks)

37. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bedroom, chair, window, watermelon. (4 marks)

38. Unscramble the letters KLAT and NEGER. (2 marks)

39. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cake, candle, present. (3 marks)

40. Write the forms of "haben" for ich, du and er. (3 marks)

41. Name two ways to make the kitchen safer at home. (2 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mother, rainbow, hair. (3 marks)

43. Fill the gaps: "Das Buch ist ___ dem Tisch. Die Katze ist ___ dem Stuhl." Use auf and unter. (2 marks)

44. Explain how the umlaut changes the word Hand in the plural. (2 marks)

45. Unscramble and write with the article: FELPA and SERI. (4 marks)

46. Write a sentence about your favourite room in German. (2 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: pot, face, father, grandmother. (4 marks)

48. Write the German words with der, die or das for: garden, room, sun, thunderstorm. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — living room
   das Wohnzimmer means living room.

2. C — Congratulations
   It is a warm congratulation or best wish.

3. B — trinken
   We drink water.

4. D — carrot
   die Karotte means carrot.

5. C — Regen and Bogen
   Regen = rain and Bogen = arch or bow: a rainbow.

6. D — good evening
   Guten Abend means good evening.

7. A — child
   das Kind means child.

8. C — there
   dort means there.

9. C — weekend
   das Wochenende means weekend.

10. D — No, thank you
   nein = no and danke = thank you.

11. A — Quotation marks
   They show the words someone says.

12. D — fünf
   5 in German is fünf.

13. A — Juni
   After Mai comes Juni.

14. C — water
   das Wasser means water.

15. C — die
   It is die Mango, so the little word is die.

16. B — die
   It is die Kartoffel, so the little word is die.

17. B — das
   It is das Bein, so the little word is das.

18. C — foggy
   Nebel is fog and neblig means foggy.

19. C — der
   It is der Wind, so the little word is der.

20. D — das Haus
   house in German is das Haus.

21. C — der Herd
   cooker in German is der Herd.

22. C — das Wohnzimmer
   living room in German is das Wohnzimmer.

23. A — der Tag
   day in German is der Tag.

24. D — das
   It is das Wochenende, so the little word is das.

25. A — gehe
   ich goes with gehe.

26. B — Mai
   May in German is Mai.

27. C — fourth
   der vierte means fourth.

28. D — sind
   Äpfel is plural, so we use sind.

29. A — windig
   Wind + -ig gives windig.

30. C — das
   It is das Wetter, so the little word is das.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Schnee, der Bruder, das Fleisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen! Wie geht's? Gut, danke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Guten Morgen, 1 mark for Wie geht's?, 1 mark for Gut, danke, 1 mark for capital letters and punctuation.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, der Kopf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means listening for the main idea, such as who is speaking and what is happening, without needing every word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the main idea, 1 mark for not needing every word.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, die Füße.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Tee, der Zahn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: das Schlafzimmer, der Stuhl, das Fenster, die Wassermelone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: kalt and Regen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each; nouns with a capital letter, adjectives with a small letter.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Kuchen, die Kerze, das Geschenk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: ich habe, du hast, er hat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct form.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep hot pots and matches away from small children; never leave the cooker alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Mutter, der Regenbogen, das Haar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: auf; unter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: a becomes ä, so die Hand becomes die Hände.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the vowel change and 1 mark for the plural.

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Apfel and der Reis.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word and 1 mark for each article.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mein Lieblingszimmer ist die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Topf, das Gesicht, der Vater, die Oma.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Garten, das Zimmer, die Sonne, das Gewitter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).
